_readme: Tolerance values of the two ISO value sets of the Measurement Report (issue #182). This file is DELIBERATELY EMPTY: whether the numbers of a paid standard may be shipped as factory values is an open licensing decision (#182, question S-2). Until it is answered every ISO cell reads '?' in the Report limits window, the ISO and Custom sets cannot be chosen for a run, and nothing is masked or hidden. Structure when filled: {"iso_12647_7": {"<row id>": number | [number, "should"]}, "iso_12647_8": {...}}; row ids are those of workflow/compliance_sets.py ROWS.
